## Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add
lib/zaq/engine/messages/outgoing.ex. Add Record list with empty default and map explicit result attachments through the existing builder; exclude runtime collection from metadata and never echo incoming attachments.

## Tests to add before implementation
Existing Outgoing suite: omitted/empty, valid explicit collection, malformed collection, no incoming echo, no runtime metadata duplication; property checks for normalization invariants.

## Branches/paths validated
Legacy text-only and supplied-file builder paths; malformed requested files must fail explicitly.

## Mocking plan
No external service needed; real structs/builders.

## Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content
Keep affected module docs accurate. Coordinate the final docs/services/channels.md update and update this issue with evidence/decisions; follow documentation hygiene.

## Action reuse assessment
Extend existing Outgoing.from_pipeline_result/2; no new builder or Agent selection. Inputs Incoming plus result; output normal Outgoing with attachments; no provider effects.

## Constraints and validation
Read parent settled decisions and applicable repository service, tool-routing, Action reuse and testing policies before implementation. Preserve current test behavior. Follow authoritative validation lifecycle; feature E2E authoring waits for final review task, but focused tests are immediate. Agent selection and #875 acquisition budgets are outside scope. No global configuration mutation.

comments.text: Live Action reuse assessment: extend existing pure Outgoing.from_pipeline_result/2 (canonical outbound builder); Record is an existing pure domain-agnostic struct. Existing pipeline/executor/API callers use this builder; no new Action or agent exposure. Inputs remain Incoming plus atom-keyed result map, output remains Outgoing for valid input, adding {:error, :invalid_attachments} for malformed explicit collection. No I/O, actor decisions, retries or runtime configuration. Strip atom/string attachment keys from merged metadata; never copy Incoming.attachments. Existing callers never supply attachments today; downstream handling for explicitly malformed new attachment requests must preserve the tagged error (Agent propagation excluded from this epic). New pure async example/property tests precede implementation; existing assertions unchanged. Service documentation finalization deferred to zaq-juu.8.
